intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Built to last, styled to impress
features.text: Our engineered wood frame is sturdy and dependable, with clean lines and thoughtful craftsmanship that elevate your everyday routine.

features.title: Headboard comfort that anchors your space
features.text: Wide, sleek, and supportive, our headboard is designed to give your room structure while offering a comfy spot to lean back at any time of day.

features.title: Lift-up storage that works with you
features.text: With a gas-lift hydraulic system, lifting the mattress feels effortless — giving you instant access to spacious, hidden storage without breaking a sweat. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Soft tones with a modern edge
features.text: Our Sonoma oak laminate brings a light, natural touch to your bedroom — fresh, clean, and ready to pair with your personal style.

features.title: Protected finish, low on fuss
features.text: The PU coating keeps your bed’s surface safe from everyday scratches and wear — preserving its look with minimal upkeep.

name: Upmods Eudora Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
